source_file: URI pricing announcement and SEC indenture
calculation_or_source: Pricing release and indenture amount
what_it_says: URNA priced/issued 1.100B USD principal amount of 6.125% senior notes due 2034.

calculation_or_source: Estimated net proceeds after initial purchasers discounts, commissions, and estimated fees/expenses

what_it_does_not_say: This is not total acquisition funding and excludes ABL borrowings.

calculation_or_source: Interest accrues at 6.125% per annum
what_it_says: The notes have a 6.125% coupon.
what_it_does_not_say: Coupon is not the offering yield or spread.

calculation_or_source: Stated maturity for principal is March 15 2034
what_it_says: The notes mature March 15 2034.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not show market price or yield.

calculation_or_source: Interest payable semiannually beginning September 15 2024
what_it_says: Interest payments began September 15 2024.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not show actual cash interest paid in later periods.

calculation_or_source: Semiannual interest payment dates
what_it_says: Interest is paid semiannually on March 15 and September 15.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not identify holders receiving interest.

what_it_does_not_say: It does not disclose exact ABL dollars or full closing source-and-use.

calculation_or_source: 6 1/8 percent Senior Notes due 2034 carrying amount in Q3 2024 debt table

what_it_does_not_say: Carrying amount is not gross principal or cash proceeds.

calculation_or_source: No optional redemption before March 15 2029 except specified provisions
what_it_says: Ordinary optional redemption begins March 15 2029.

calculation_or_source: Redemption price for 12-month period beginning March 15 2029
what_it_says: Optional redemption in 2029 starts at 103.063% of principal plus accrued/unpaid interest.
what_it_does_not_say: This is not market price or yield.

calculation_or_source: Redemption price for 12-month period beginning March 15 2030
what_it_says: Optional redemption in 2030 is 102.042% plus accrued/unpaid interest.
what_it_does_not_say: This is not market price or yield.

calculation_or_source: Redemption price for 12-month period beginning March 15 2031
what_it_says: Optional redemption in 2031 is 101.021% plus accrued/unpaid interest.
what_it_does_not_say: This is not market price or yield.

calculation_or_source: Redemption price for 2032 and thereafter
what_it_says: Optional redemption in 2032 and thereafter is at par plus accrued/unpaid interest.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not mean redemption is planned.

source_detail: Form of security equity offering redemption
calculation_or_source: Up to 40% of principal may be redeemed with equity offering proceeds on or before March 15 2027
what_it_says: The indenture includes an equity-claw redemption path.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not mean an equity offering occurred.

source_detail: Form of security equity offering redemption
calculation_or_source: Equity-claw redemption price
what_it_says: The equity-claw redemption price is 106.125% of principal plus accrued/unpaid interest.
what_it_does_not_say: This is not market price or yield.

calculation_or_source: If Yak failed to close by deadline or purchase agreement terminated, notes required redemption at 100% plus accrued/unpaid interest
what_it_says: The note indenture directly tied the financing to Yak through a special mandatory redemption provision.
what_it_does_not_say: The acquisition did close, so this is a contingency term, not a realized redemption.

calculation_or_source: Change-of-control offer at 101% of principal plus accrued/unpaid interest
what_it_says: The 10-Q summarizes a change-of-control repurchase obligation.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not mean a change of control occurred.
